simple.meaning: פֵּאָה (pêʼâh) appears 86 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Joshua, Nehemiah, and 3 more, beginning at Exodus 25:26. The background comes from the surrounding verses where the name appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פֵּאָה (H6285) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows פֵּאָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
